description: Dated ways the Maven-published admin client (built from keycloak/keycloak-client) reads HEAD differently from raw HTTP. Each entry pins one difference of JsonDiff.diff(raw, adapter) by operation, path and kind (MISSING_RIGHT: the adapter drops a field the server sent). An entry that explains nothing in a full run is stale and fails the build.

lag.reason: HEAD's IdentityProviderRepresentation carries the organizations an IdP is linked to as organizationLinks; the adapter's copy (keycloak-client-common-synced) still has only the older organizationId, and the adapter ignores unknown properties, so the links are dropped.
